notes.title: Our biggest update
notes.notes:
[url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Demo[/url]
[url=https://www.bigadventure.games/newsletter]Newsletter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/GaxP5z4hjn]Discord[/url]

We're not kidding with that title either, we've added FIVE TIMES as much content in 0.8 compared to the amount we added in 0.7.

Here are the headlines:

[*] 5 new monsters for Super Supreme to go up against
[*] 13 new cartridges for you to add to your build
[*] 6 new mods to tip battles in Super Supreme's favor
[*] 4 new effects, one of which could make or break your next playthrough
[*] 4 new events, doubling the total that can show up each run.
[*] and last but not least, 4 new music tracks to get you in the zone as you check out the update

Enough talking about it! We understand if you want to dig in and play right now, so here's a convenient download link to take you straight to the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/1dd76ebb4e427f82dbe3df0abbfbe5b269dd2509.png[/img]

So why so much content for this update?

The answer is simple... Because we need it. 
We want Dream Team Supreme to be an engaging and replayable experience. In order to achieve that we need you to have access to a whole suite of strategic options in your playthroughs.

To do that, we added more cartridges to find in your playthroughs...
To support those cartridges, we added new status effects...
To support those status effects, we added new locations and mods...
and to test your skills with these new options, we added new monsters.

Well. What are the highlights of all this content?
[*]'Burning' is a new effect you can find on mods, cartridges and some enemy move sets. This offers you a new way to take down monsters... but careful you don't overheat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/14c2d4ebd46eec837a1bb94908820f176b501039.png[/img]

[*]There are new monsters that aim to counter scientists whose strategy relies on conserving momentum for a single powerful blow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/afb1f8b85929c1dd60c7d326817bc2c9a27086eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/477d721b830a7bb3a7ddd5c422a2b69cc390ece0.png[/img]

[*]And we added some new locations to introduce some more nuanced risk vs reward into your deckbuilding strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/6d7e37cd637bb5cb91f7a11cfa4660df7fc333a4.png[/img]

This isn't all we've been working on either!

We've still been hard at work getting touch screen and controller support ready for you. We've got all the structure in place, so hopefully it won't be long before you can try one of our updates with your favourite controller in your hand.

We're really excited about this new update and we hope you enjoy it!

Stay sharp scientists,

Tom from Big Adventure
